entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="危険だと警告されたの。オダとも連絡が取れないし、何か変だわ" t="I was alerted of a threat. Oda is not answering. Something isn't right." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="危険だと警告されたの。オダとも連絡が取れないし、何か変だわ" t="Am fost alertată de o amenințare. Oda nu răspunde. Ceva nu e în regulă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私が参加したのは、あくまでもお父様を追悼するため" t="I only agreed to this to honor the memory of our father." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私が参加したのは、あくまでもお父様を追悼するため" t="Am acceptat doar pentru a onora memoria tatălui nostru." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="操り人形になるためじゃないわ" t="But now I've started to feel like your puppet." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="操り人形になるためじゃないわ" t="Dar acum am început să mă simt ca o marionetă a ta." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="パレードを中止すれば、弱さを露呈したと思われる" t="If we cancel the celebrations, it will be taken as a sign of weakness." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="パレードを中止すれば、弱さを露呈したと思われる" t="Dacă anulăm sărbătorile, va fi considerat un semn de slăbiciune." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="弱さ？ 誰の？ あなたの？" t="Weakness? Whose? Yours?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="弱さ？ 誰の？ あなたの？" t="Slăbiciune? A cui? A ta?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="だが、お前が言うなら中止してもいい。全部やめだ。お前の安全が第一だからな" t="But I understand. One word from you and we can end this, it can all be over. Your safety is most important to me." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="だが、お前が言うなら中止してもいい。全部やめだ。お前の安全が第一だからな" t="Dar înțeleg. Un cuvânt de la tine și putem pune capăt, totul se poate termina. Siguranța ta e cea mai importantă pentru mine." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="お父様…" t="For father." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="お父様…" t="Pentru tată." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="お許しを。どうか、話だけでもお聞きください" t="Please forgive me, Hanako-sama. I only ask that you listen to me." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="お許しを。どうか、話だけでもお聞きください" t="Iartă-mă, Hanako-sama. Te rog doar să mă asculți." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="サブロウ様は…" t="Your father..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="サブロウ様は…" t="Tatăl tău..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="父のことを口にしないで！" t="How dare you speak of him?!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="父のことを口にしないで！" t="Cum îndrăznești să vorbești despre el?!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハナコ様、無礼を働きたくありません。しかし…" t="Hanako-sama, please. Don't make me do this..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハナコ様、無礼を働きたくありません。しかし…" t="Hanako-sama, te rog. Nu mă face să fac asta..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: V, run!
entries.ro: V, fugi!

entries.en: Shit! Shit! Shit!
entries.ro: Căcat! Căcat! Căcat!

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="兄さん…" t="Yorinobu?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="兄さん…" t="Yorinobu?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="やり終えましょう" t="We must finish it." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="やり終えましょう" t="Trebuie să terminăm." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ありがとう、ハナコ。せっかくの式典だ――やり終えなければ、悔いが残る" t="Thank you, Hanako. It would have been a shame not to finish so heartwarming a ceremony." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ありがとう、ハナコ。せっかくの式典だ――やり終えなければ、悔いが残る" t="Mulțumesc, Hanako. Ar fi fost păcat să nu terminăm o ceremonie atât de emoționantă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Thsp…
entries.ro: Thsp…

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハナコ様" t="Hanako-sama." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハナコ様" t="Hanako-sama." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あなたは…" t="It's you..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あなたは…" t="Tu ești..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="これが、俺にできる最後のご奉仕なのです" t="This is the last thing I can do for him." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="これが、俺にできる最後のご奉仕なのです" t="Asta e ultimul lucru pe care-l pot face pentru el." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="サブロウ様の死について真実を明かすことが" t="To reveal to you the truth about his death." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="サブロウ様の死について真実を明かすことが" t="Să-ți dezvălui adevărul despre moartea lui." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="この見せ物では、みんなに役割がある。ミチコは文句を言ってないぞ" t="Everyone has their role to play in this spectacle. Michiko has no problem with that." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="この見せ物では、みんなに役割がある。ミチコは文句を言ってないぞ" t="Fiecare are rolul său în acest spectacol. Michiko nu are nicio problemă cu asta." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="なぜ止まったんだ？" t="Why did you stop?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="なぜ止まったんだ？" t="De ce te-ai oprit?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="俺たちだ" t="Ours." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="俺たちだ" t="Al nostru." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Whatever he did, now we're really fucked!
entries.ro: Orice ar fi făcut, acum ne-am futut de-a binelea!

entries.en: Hanako's inside.
entries.ro: Hanako e înăuntru.

entries.en: Tryna call someone, I think.
entries.ro: Cred că încearcă să sune pe cineva.

entries.en: Try to listen.
entries.ro: Încearcă să asculți.

entries.en: Do not forget to disarm the alarms. I must be able to enter.
entries.ro: Nu uita să dezactivezi alarmele. Trebuie să intru.

entries.en: Goro? All systems jammed. It's now or never.
entries.ro: Goro? Toate sistemele sunt blocate. Acum sau niciodată.

entries.en: What is she doing?
entries.ro: Ce face ea?

entries.en: Hurry, V!
entries.ro: Grăbește-te, V!

entries.en: V, it will be too late soon!
entries.ro: V, o să fie prea târziu!

entries.en: You have no right to keep us here!
entries.ro: Nu aveți dreptul să ne țineți aici!

entries.en: On the ground! Everyone!
entries.ro: La pământ! Toată lumea!

entries.en: Go fuck yourself! This is a violation of our civil rights!
entries.ro: Du-te-n pula mea! Asta e o încălcare a drepturilor noastre civile!

entries.en: Halt!
entries.ro: Stați!

entries.en: Does anyone else have anything to say about civil rights?! You can join him!
entries.ro: Mai are cineva ceva de zis despre drepturile civile?! Hai, alătură-te lui!

entries.en: I almost got trampled... Broken ribs, I think…
entries.ro: Era cât p-ai clipi să fiu călcat în picioare... Cred că am coaste rupte…

entries.en: We need to get out of here!
entries.ro: Trebuie să ieșim de-aici!

entries.en: I look OK to you? We're about to go live.
entries.ro: Arăt eu bine? Intrăm în direct imediat.

entries.en: Three, two, one...
entries.ro: Trei, doi, unu...

entries.en: This is Gillean Jordan of N54 News coming to you live from Japantown, where a commemorative parade in honor of Saburo Arasaka descended into chaos today.
entries.ro: Aici Gillean Jordan, de la N54 News, în direct din Japantown. O paradă comemorativă în onoarea lui Saburo Arasaka a degenerat în haos astăzi.

entries.en: Eyewitnesses we've spoken to described a shootout on one of the celebratory floats. The float in question is said to have been transporting Hanako Arasaka.
entries.ro: Martorii oculari cu care am vorbit povestesc despre un schimb de focuri pe una dintre platformele festive. Se zice că platforma în cauză ar fi transportat-o pe Hanako Arasaka.

entries.en: Unfortunately, I have no further details to report at this time.
entries.ro: Din păcate, deocamdată nu am alte detalii.

entries.en: We are still awaiting an official statement from the Arasaka Corporation regarding these events.
entries.ro: Încă așteptăm o declarație oficială de la Corporația Arasaka despre ce s-a întâmplat.

entries.en: Hey! Stay out of the shot!
entries.ro: Hei! Ieși din cadru!

entries.en: Ugh, dammit... Let's do it again!
entries.ro: Ugh, la naiba... Hai s-o luăm de la capăt!

entries.en: Thank you! People're working here!
entries.ro: Mersi! Lucrăm și noi aici!

entries.en: As the situation continues to be brought under control, we urge everyone to avoid Kanzaki Street.
entries.ro: Situația e tot mai sub control, așa că vă rugăm să evitați strada Kanzaki.

entries.en: Knew we couldn't trust him! What happened to keepin' him on his leash?!
entries.ro: Știam că nu-i putem da încredere! Ce, nu-l mai ținea nimeni în lesă?!

entries.en: We'd best delta the fuck outta here.
entries.ro: Hai s-o tăiem dracu' de-aici!

entries.en: He shot her?!
entries.ro: Chiar a împușcat-o?!

entries.en: [Deactivate  security measures]
entries.ro: [Dezactivează măsurile de securitate]
